ORB01_MODERN_5M_FORMED: Modern formed 5m ORB family; directional opening-range and long-term trend gates. NQ implementation is a research port.
ORB02_VALUE_AREA_FLOW: Modern NQ value-area/order-flow ORB working research. Exact MBO delta is not available in the current public OHLCV mirror; the suite labels and tests an OHLCV proxy rather than pretending it is exact.
ORB03_DELAYED_25M: Mesfin (2026), Structural Limits of OHLCV-Based Intraday Signals in MNQ Futures. Tests immediate vs delayed ORB-style confirmation on MNQ; suite implements the mechanism family.
ORB04_TSAI_TORB: Tsai et al. (2019), Assessing the Profitability of Timely Opening Range Breakout on Index Futures Markets, IEEE Access. Direct E-mini Nasdaq-100 evidence; short probe periods including 1 minute are tested.
ORB05_VOL_STATE: Lundstrom (2019), Day Trading Returns Across Volatility States. Refereed ORB research on futures showing strong state dependence; mechanism transferred to NQ.
ORB06_STAT_THRESHOLD: Holmberg, Lonnbark & Lundstrom (2013), Assessing the profitability of intraday opening range breakout strategies, Finance Research Letters 10(1):27-33. Statistical/volatility threshold ORB mechanism transferred to NQ.
ORB07_GAORB_FULL_GRID: Wu, Syu, Lin & Ho (2021), Evolutionary ORB-based model with protective closing strategies, Knowledge-Based Systems 216:106769. Threshold-adjusted ORB and protective closing. We exhaustively grid the encoded family rather than rely on GA selection.
ORB08_NN_THRESHOLD: Chen, Syu & Ho (2020), Neural Network-based ORB Strategies for Threshold Classification on Taiwan Futures Market, IEEE SMC. Neural threshold gate reconstructed on NQ.
ORB09_PREDICTED_TR: Wu et al. (2026), Enhancing Opening Range Breakout Strategies with LSTM-Based True Range Prediction, ACIIDS / Springer LNCS. The suite uses a causal gradient-boosting TR forecast surrogate and labels it reconstruction.
ORB10_NQ_GAP_STATE: Yu, Rentzler & Wolf (2005), NASDAQ-100 Index Futures: Intraday Momentum or Reversal?, Journal of Investment Management 3(3). Direct NQ prior-day/overnight state evidence used as an ORB gate.
